conclusion: The remaining gap is read-exposure provenance and a coverage-matched identity/compact experiment, alongside live owner-admitted compact-edit routing if later desired. Current initial projection already defers optional program bodies. Whole-filesystem minification is not a prerequisite for reducing model-visible disclosure, and existing mapper/application receipts or replay receipts are not token-saving evidence.

findings.statement: The standard initial-context producer supplies the public query to bounded worker projection. Program raw bodies are not all copied inline by default. The worker payload retains required raw paths and nondeferred support; optional program sources are identified for exact later fetch. Capsules do not claim equivalence to omitted source.

static_population.budget_limit_scope: Worker semantic payload target; required/support data, outer semantic transport, instruction block, workspace advisory, tools and CLI scaffolding require separate accounting.
static_population.projection_deferred_sources_formula: selected paths outside required_raw_paths that are program paths, deferred task data, or any optional path when no signed program partition is supplied
static_population.projection_raw_sources_formula: required_raw_paths union (selected_paths minus program_paths minus deferred_task_data) when a signed program/support partition exists; otherwise required_raw_paths only
static_population.signed_partition: Program paths derive from profile input_paths excluding data_inputs. Support includes instruction, task profile, structural smoke and validated task data. Defer-task-data handling is explicit.
static_population.unprojected_fallback: When worker_query is absent, raw-source-required admissions and nonsymbol source files can add further raw source.

findings.public_source_size_interpretation: 642 + 2246 input-file bytes. This is not a subtraction from prompt bytes and does not prove both files occupied the same historical source partition.
findings.statement: Historical closed runtime observations retain complete input sizes and hashes, not a raw_sources path/body-size census. They do not independently establish exact inline-versus-deferred source byte totals. Current projection behavior must not be described as full-codebase raw-body duplication.

A projected payload still contains capsule structures, admission receipts, manifest/source identities, selected-symbol and deferred-source metadata, context-pack bindings, and required/support source. The coding route adds wrappers, literal requirements and optional source-reader guidance. Omitting program bodies alone therefore does not bound the complete model context to the source body size.

The native coding route appends the authenticated literal instruction after semantic encoding, while the required instruction may also occupy raw_sources. Existing instruction-aware metadata projection references only that exact bound raw-source entry and retains the unchanged literal instruction block. This is a narrow existing deduplication path; other source and unknown fields stay preserved.

Source-view enablement adds optional reader guidance and descriptor transport. It does not replace or intercept native workspace readers. Coding tool policy includes read_file, grep and run_terminal_cmd, so direct cat/sed/rg or program-driven reads can disclose original source without a worker-source request. The declared allowlist explicitly does not claim effective toolset verification. This review establishes exposure, not that every historical session took that bypass.

Codex session JSONL is read as recorded response_item function/custom-tool calls and outputs. The exported receipt currently keeps only aggregate call/output counts and lexical path/error indicators, plus a digest of the full retained rollout. It does not export per-call identities, paths/spans, request/result hashes or byte counts. A local private read ledger can be derived while parsing retained records, but historical published aggregate diagnostics alone cannot reconstruct read exposure.

Grok stream capture counts tool names and status changes. It does not retain arguments, result content hashes, per-call joins or path/span/source-generation bindings. Read-event provenance must be normalized before these event details are discarded; it cannot be recovered from the final count-only snapshot.

The existing broker records ordinal, request/response hashes, prepared response bytes and whether delivery succeeded. Source-view observation aggregates prepared/delivered source and candidate-context bytes and unique hashes. Those observations do not join a source span to an actual native tool-output item or establish provider tokenization/delivery. Transport bytes must not be added to native cumulative input tokens a second time.

The normalized comparison deduplicates invocation identities and retains provider-scoped final native counts, input observation and progress. It is sufficient for stated native-session totals when completeness is established, but lacks per-read provenance needed to attribute savings to compact disclosure. Preserve existing provider-specific cache and completeness semantics instead of adding a new token counter or owner.

The pure mapper authenticates the original/view/map and requires the original-source candidate to project to the requested edited view. The host adapter now applies one modified text file in a clean fenced IsolatedWorktree through its existing lease, PatchScope and apply_patch owner, checks full admitted postimage, and refreshes working generation. The socket remains read-only, and no authenticated model compact-edit tool or live Terminal-Bench arm is enabled by this adapter.

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Retain invocation identity, native session/rollout hash, source manifest/scope hash, task identity and current workspace generation. Do not create a second source owner or provider counter.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Bind exposure ledger to existing invocation and session owners

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Join stable native call IDs to request and result hashes, serialized UTF-8 byte counts, completion/truncation status and an observed route label. Export bounded hashes/counts, not raw source, terminal output or credentials.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Normalize native tool request and result events privately

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Relate worker request/response hashes to the CLI display projection and its native tool call. Keep prepared, delivered-to-client, printed and observed-in-native-stream states separate; never infer provider delivery from socket delivery.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Join recognized worker responses to actual printed native outputs

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: For qualified read_file/worker-reader formats, retain path identity, original/view identity, generation, byte or line-span coordinate type, page cursor and exact source/view hashes. An unqualified CLI command cannot claim exact span coverage.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Record exact recognized source disclosure coordinates

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: At the existing context compiler/router boundary, derive required/support raw paths and encoded bytes, deferred raw identities, capsules/admissions/pack/manifest bytes, literal instruction, source guidance, wrappers and selected complete-input digest. Report component sums only under a declared serialization accounting method; nested bytes are not independent addends.

Track known source spans shown compactly, later exact original expansions, repeated disclosures and generation invalidation. Count repeated tool output as repeated exposure; unioned source coverage is a separate metric.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Keep compact-read and raw-expansion coverage separate

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Freeze one admitted task/context and tool request; use identity@1 and conservative compact profiles through the same reader/display envelope and guidance, with the same required facts. Compare complete rendered native outputs under one compatible tokenizer. This provider-free fixture would isolate display/codec overhead, not establish complete-session savings.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Evaluate same-channel identity versus compact disclosure

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Match public source generation, provider/model/reasoning settings, checkpoint and IR profiles, tool schemas/guidance, planning mode, resource limits and acceptance. Keep existing capsule/metadata selection fixed when isolating source representation. Include exact-read-before-edit fallback in both arms; balance order and repeat tasks. Retain official success, failures/repair calls and final native usage once per invocation. Use a frozen plan for a mechanistic disclosure experiment and label independently planned full runs separately.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Run matched complete-session operational pairs only after admission gates

proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.details: Preserve literal goal, scope, acceptance constraints and required source identities; explicitly mark unverified semantic facts. Optional program spans can remain deferred only with an available generation-bound resolver and coverage frontier. Learned IR, capsule selection, byte restoration and historical replay do not certify complete task coverage.
proposed_operations_not_implemented_by_t.operation: Define declared task-coverage obligations at the existing context owner

scope: Read-only source and retained public-evidence review; this new JSON is the only artifact created by this review.

unknown_handling.arbitrary_terminal_commands: Classify as unclassified_terminal_io unless a separately qualified exact command/output parser establishes the read. cat/rg text references alone do not prove path, complete source span, writes or causal savings. Shell pipelines, Python scripts, subprocesses, redirects and dynamic paths remain unknown rather than invented source reads.
unknown_handling.component_bytes: Measure actual selected wire serialization; do not sum nested source/capsule representations twice.
unknown_handling.missing_or_duplicate_native_call_ids: Do not infer a unique join; retain conflict/unknown status and deterministic request/result hashes without double-counting completed usage.
unknown_handling.missing_provider_usage_or_counter_identi: Retain unknown totals or counters; do not manufacture zeros or comparable token savings.
unknown_handling.source_drift_or_missing_generation_pin: Do not merge source coverage across generations or reuse stale source/proof applicability.
unknown_handling.truncated_failed_or_malformed_output: Preserve observed byte lower bounds and failure status; complete output exposure stays unknown.
unknown_handling.unjoined_worker_request: Retain prepared/delivered broker evidence but leave native-output exposure unverified.
unknown_handling.unknown_tool_events: Keep bounded unclassified event counts and mark exposure completeness false/unknown.
